description: A hosted website's own Backsies schedules (Pro, up to 5 per site, on top of the included ones). action list (default) shows every schedule with its next run; set adds one or, with scheduleId, changes it: schedule hourly|daily|weekly|monthly, hour and minute (Finnish time), weekday 0-6 (weekly), monthday 1-28 (monthly), every 1|2|3|4|6|8|12 (hourly: every N hours from hour), contents files and/or databases, keep 1-168. schedule times runs each day at times (HH:MM list, up to 12). name sets the site's own name. Files need 4 hours between runs; the database can run every hour. list also returns tips: advice from how scheduled backups ran (slow, waited, failing, sameTime, bigSiteFrequentFiles, spaceLow). remove (scheduleId) deletes one of the site's own; turn_off / turn_on (scheduleId of an included schedule) switch an included schedule off or back on for this site only; set with replacesId saves the site's own version and turns that included schedule off.

action.description: list (default), set (add or change), remove (own schedule), turn_off / turn_on (included schedule, this site only).

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

every.description: set hourly: every N hours, counted from hour.

keep.description: set: backups to keep (space counts against the storage limit).

name.description: set: the site's own name for the schedule.

replacesId.description: set: included schedule this new one replaces (turned off for this site).

schedule.description: set: how often. hourly = every `every` hours; times = each day at `times`; files need 4 h between runs.

scheduleId.description: set (change) / remove / turn_off / turn_on: schedule id from list.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

times.description: set times: times of day, HH:MM Finnish time.

name: oma_backsies_schedule
title: Website backup schedules
